Paragraph: "Yet, when this cool breeze touches me, my longing for Seetha only burns hotter, like wind fanning the flames of a forest fire..."
Situation/Problem_Faced: The paradoxical effect where soothing external conditions inflame internal psychological pain.
Key_Teaching/Action_Taken: Rama observes how the cool breeze acts as an emotional catalyst, intensifying his inner turmoil.
Outcome/Resolution: He articulates the complex nature of emotional triggers.

Spiritual_Psychological_Concept_Indian.Concept: Viraha-Agni-Vardhana (The paradox of comforting elements increasing the fire of separation)

Brief_Summary_Spiritual: Illustrates how worldly comforts cannot soothe a soul yearning for divine union; instead, they highlight the ache of separation.
Brief_Summary_Psychological: Psychological paradox: external calming agents fail to reduce distress when core emotional needs remain unfulfilled, sometimes heightening grief.
